news.headline: Ugonna Onyenso thought his NBA dream was over -- then the Detroit Pistons called him up
news.description: Detroit Pistons center Ugonna Onyenso was surprised to hear his name called out 53rd at the 2026 NBA Draft, having once believed his dream of making the league was over, but is now confident he can grow into the sizable shoes left by Isaiah Stewart.
